nodes.name: Start of Adventure
nodes.description: The player characters begin their journey escorting a wagon from Neverwinter to Phandalin.
nodes.boxed_text:
In the city of Neverwinter, a dwarf named Gundren Rockseeker asked you to bring a wagonload of provisions to the rough-and-tumble settlement of Phandalin, a couple of days' travel southeast of the city. Gundren was clearly excited and more than a little secretive about his reasons for the trip, saying only that he and his brothers had found "something big," and that he'd pay you ten gold pieces each for escorting his supplies safely to Barthen's Provisions, a trading post in Phandalin. He then set out ahead of you on horse, along with a warrior escort named Sildar Hallwinter, claiming he needed to arrive early to "take care of business."

You've spent the last few days following the High Road south from Neverwinter, and you've just recently veered east along the Triboar Trail.

You've encountered no trouble so far, but this territory can be dangerous. Bandits and outlaws have been known to lurk along the trail.

nodes.name: Goblin Ambush
nodes.description: The party encounters a goblin ambush on the Triboar Trail.
nodes.boxed_text: You've been on the Triboar Trail for about half a day. As you come around a bend, you spot two dead horses sprawled about fifty feet ahead of you, blocking the path. Each has several black-feathered arrows sticking out of it. The woods press close to the trail here, with a steep embankment and dense thickets on either side.

nodes.name: Investigation Scene
nodes.description: The party investigates the dead horses and finds looted saddlebags and an empty map case.
nodes.boxed_text: The saddlebags have been looted. Nearby lies an empty leather map case.

nodes.name: Goblin Trail
nodes.description: A hidden trail used by goblins for ambushes, leading to the Cragmaw hideout.

nodes.name: Phandalin
nodes.description: A small town where characters can visit multiple locations and NPCs throughout a day.

nodes.name: Snare Trap
nodes.description: A hidden snare trap set by goblins to catch pursuers.

nodes.name: Pit Trap
nodes.description: A hidden pit trap in the hallway that collapses under 100 or more pounds of weight.

nodes.name: Cragmaw Hideout
nodes.description: Hideout of the Cragmaw tribe of goblins, led by a bugbear named Klarg.

nodes.name: Goblin Interrogation
nodes.description: Characters can capture or charm goblins to gain information.
nodes.boxed_text:
If the characters capture or charm any of the goblins here, the goblins can be persuaded to divulge some useful information:

- About fifteen goblins currently dwell in the lair.
- Their leader is a bugbear named Klarg. He answers to King Grol, chief of the Cragmaw tribe, who dwells in Cragmaw Castle. (The goblins can provide basic directions to Cragmaw Castle. It's about twenty miles northeast of the Cragmaw hideout, in Neverwinter Wood.)
- Klarg received a messenger goblin from King Grol a few days ago. The messenger told him that someone named the Black Spider was paying the Cragmaws to watch out for the dwarf Gundren Rockseeker, capture him, and send him and anything he was carrying back to King Grol. Klarg followed his orders. Gundren was ambushed and taken along with his personal effects, including a map.
- The dwarf and his map were delivered to King Grol, as instructed. The dwarf's human companion is being held in the "eating cave" (area 6).

nodes.name: Cave Mouth
nodes.description: Entrance to the Cragmaw hideout, located five miles from the goblin ambush site.
nodes.boxed_text: Following the goblins' trail, you come across a large cave in a hillside five miles from the scene of the ambush. A shallow stream flows out of the cave mouth, which is screened by dense briar thickets. A narrow dry path leads into the cave on the right-hand side of the stream.

nodes.name: Area 1
nodes.description: Location where characters are washed down to if they fail to avoid the flood.

nodes.name: Area 2
nodes.description: A location northwest of the Open Pit.

nodes.name: Goblin Attack
nodes.description: Goblins attack the characters if they make a lot of noise in area 1.

nodes.name: Goblin Blind
nodes.description: A goblin guard post on the east side of the stream, hidden in briar thickets.
nodes.boxed_text: On the east side of the stream flowing from the cave mouth, a small area in the briar thickets has been hollowed out to form a lookout post or blind. Wooden planks flatten out the briars and provide room for guards to lie hidden and watch the area—including a pair of goblins lurking there right now!

nodes.name: Goblin Encounter
nodes.description: Encounter with two goblins who may attack if they notice the characters.

nodes.name: Thickets
nodes.description: Dense thickets on the north side of the road make it difficult to go around the webs.

nodes.name: Kennel
nodes.description: A small, dank chamber on the east side of the passage with chained wolves.
nodes.boxed_text: Just inside the cave mouth, a few uneven stone steps lead up to a small, dank chamber on the east side of the passage. The cave narrows to a steep fissure at the far end, and is filled with the stench of animals. Savage snarls and the sounds of rattling chains greet your ears where three wolves are chained up just inside the opening. Each wolf's chain leads to an iron rod driven into the base of a stalagmite.

nodes.name: Fissure
nodes.description: A narrow opening in the east wall leads to a natural chimney that climbs 30 feet to area 8.

nodes.name: Wolf Frenzy
nodes.description: Wolves are driven into a frenzy and attempt to free themselves from chains.

nodes.name: Steep Passage
nodes.description: A steep passage with a stream plunging down its west side and a side passage leading west.
nodes.boxed_text: The main passage from the cave mouth climbs steeply upward, the stream plunging and splashing down its west side. In the shadows, a side passage leads west across the other side of the stream.

nodes.name: View of the Bridge
nodes.description: Characters can spot a rickety bridge above the passage.
nodes.boxed_text: In the shadows of the ceiling to the north, you can just make out the dim shape of a rickety bridge of wood and rope crossing over the passage ahead of you. Another passage intersects this one, twenty feet above the floor.

nodes.name: Goblin Guard
nodes.description: A goblin guards the bridge and may notice the characters.

nodes.name: Western Passage
nodes.description: A passage choked with rubble and steep escarpments, considered difficult terrain.

nodes.name: Overpass
nodes.description: A high tunnel with a bridge guard post set up by goblins.
nodes.boxed_text: The stream passage continues up beyond another set of uneven steps ahead, bending eastward as it goes. A waterfall sounds out from a larger cavern somewhere ahead of you.

nodes.name: Bridge
nodes.description: A bridge spanning the passage 20 feet above the stream, with rough but slick walls.

nodes.name: Flood!
nodes.description: A surge of water is released from area 7, flooding the main passage of the lair.
nodes.boxed_text: The passage is suddenly filled with a mighty roar, as a huge surge of rushing water pours down from above!

nodes.name: Area 7
nodes.description: Location where goblins can release a flood by knocking away supports.

nodes.name: Area 5
nodes.description: Location with a lookout goblin who signals the goblins in area 7.

nodes.name: Area 4
nodes.description: Disused passage where creatures can attempt to avoid the flood.

nodes.name: Area 3
nodes.description: A location east of the Open Pit.

nodes.name: Goblin Den
nodes.description: A large cave used as a common room and barracks by the Cragmaw raiders.
nodes.boxed_text: This large cave is divided in half by a ten-foot-high escarpment. A steep natural staircase leads from the lower portion to the upper ledge. The air is hazy with the smoke of a cooking fire, and pungent from the smell of poorly cured hides and unwashed goblins.

nodes.name: Roleplaying Sildar
nodes.description: Sildar Hallwinter provides information and offers a quest to the characters.

nodes.name: Sildar Rescue
nodes.description: Sildar Hallwinter is rescued and can join the party.

nodes.name: Treasure
nodes.description: Yeemik carries a pouch containing three gold teeth and 15 silver pieces. Sildar's gear and Gundren Rockseeker were taken to Cragmaw Castle.

nodes.name: NPC Party Members
nodes.description: Guidelines for running an NPC party member, including decision-making, combat behavior, and XP distribution.

nodes.name: Twin Pools Cave
nodes.description: A cavern half filled with two large pools of water, with a waterfall and multiple exits.
nodes.boxed_text: This cavern is half filled with two large pools of water. A narrow waterfall high in the eastern wall feeds the pool, which drains out the western end of the chamber to form the stream that flows out of the cave mouth below. Low fieldstone walls serve as dams holding the water in. A wide exit stands to the south, while two smaller passages lead west. The sound of the waterfall echoes through the cavern, making it difficult to hear.

nodes.name: Eye Monster Guarded Area
nodes.description: The lower part of the complex guarded by a hideous 'eye monster'.

nodes.name: Rock Dams
nodes.description: The goblins built simple dams to control the flow of water through the heart of the complex.

nodes.name: Klarg's Cave
nodes.description: The leader of the goblinoids keeps the bulk of the raiders' stolen goods in his den. The Cragmaws' plunder from the last month of raiding and ambushing caravans is here.
nodes.boxed_text: Sacks and crates of looted provisions are piled up in the south end of this large cave. To the west, the floor slopes toward a narrow opening that descends into darkness. A larger opening leads north down a set of natural stone steps, the roar of falling water echoing from beyond. In the middle of the cavern, the coals of a large fire smolder.

nodes.name: Fire Pit
nodes.description: A central fire pit with hot coals that deal fire damage.

nodes.name: Natural Chimney
nodes.description: A niche in the western wall forms the top of a shaft that descends 30 feet to area 3.

nodes.name: Supplies
nodes.description: An area with piles of sacks and crates, providing half cover and containing a hidden treasure chest.

nodes.name: Klarg's Ambush
nodes.description: Klarg and his wolf hide behind stalagmites while goblins take cover behind supplies to ambush the characters.

nodes.name: Chimney Surprise
nodes.description: Characters can surprise Klarg by climbing the chimney from area 3.

nodes.name: Wolf Killed
nodes.description: If the wolf is killed, Klarg attempts to flee by climbing down the chimney to area 3.

nodes.name: Treasure Room
nodes.description: A room containing the last items the spectator was charged to protect.

nodes.name: Cragmaw Castle
nodes.description: A dilapidated castle shored up by goblins, with various structural features.

nodes.name: Arrival in Phandalin
nodes.description: The adventurers arrive in Phandalin, setting the stage for a confrontation with the Redbrands.

nodes.name: Sildar's Addition
nodes.description: Sildar Hallwinter suggests securing lodgings at the local inn.
nodes.boxed_text:
Sildar seems much more at ease.

"My friends," he says, "let us secure lodgings. I'm told the local inn is very quaint."

nodes.name: Stonehill Inn
nodes.description: A place where adventurers can rest and gather information in Phandalin.

nodes.name: Barthen's Provisions
nodes.description: The biggest trading post in Phandalin, stocking most ordinary goods and supplies.

nodes.name: Lionshield Coster
nodes.description: A modest trading post owned by the Lionshields, a merchant company based in Yartar. The outpost has been affected by banditry.
nodes.boxed_text: Hanging above the front door of this modest trading post is a sign shaped like a wooden shield with a blue lion painted on it.

nodes.name: Phandalin
nodes.description: A small frontier town with various locations such as an inn, town hall, shrine, general stores, trading posts, and other homes and businesses.
nodes.boxed_text: There's an inn, a town hall, a shrine, general stores and trading posts, and a few other homes and businesses. Where do you want to go?

nodes.name: Redbrand Ruffians
nodes.description: An encounter with Redbrand thugs at The Sleeping Giant.

nodes.name: Finding Cragmaw Castle
nodes.description: The characters seek out Cragmaw Castle to find and rescue Gundren Rockseeker.

nodes.name: Phandalin NPCs
nodes.description: Guidance on roleplaying NPCs in Phandalin, including tips for introducing and interacting with them.

nodes.name: Narth, an old farmer
nodes.description: Encounter with Narth, an old farmer who provides information about Sister Garaele.
nodes.boxed_text: Sister Garaele, who oversees the Shrine of Luck, recently left town for a few days, then returned wounded and exhausted.

nodes.name: Elsa, a gossipy barmaid
nodes.description: Elsa is a barmaid known for her gossiping nature.
nodes.boxed_text: "Daran Edermath, the orchard keeper, is a former adventurer."

nodes.name: Lanar, a miner
nodes.description: Lanar is a miner who provides information about orc raiders.
nodes.boxed_text: "Orc raiders have been seen on the east end of Triboar Trail. The townmaster is looking for someone to run them off."

nodes.name: Trilena, the innkeeper's wife
nodes.description: Trilena shares information about Thel Dendrar's confrontation with the Redbrands and his subsequent murder.
nodes.boxed_text: Thel Dendrar, a local woodcarver, stood up to the Redbrands a tenday ago when they came by his shop and leered at his wife. The ruffians murdered him. Several townsfolk saw it happen. The Redbrands grabbed his body, and now his wife, daughter, and son have gone missing too.

nodes.name: Redbrand Hideout
nodes.description: The hideout where the bugbears reside and hold information about Wave Echo Cave and Cragmaw Castle.

nodes.name: Pip, Toblen's young son
nodes.description: Pip is the young son of Toblen, who shares information about a secret tunnel.
nodes.boxed_text: Qelline Alderleaf's son Carp said he found a secret tunnel in the woods, but Redbrands almost caught him.

nodes.name: Freda, a weaver
nodes.description: Freda is a weaver who provides information about the Redbrands and their avoidance of the Phandalin Miner's Exchange.
nodes.boxed_text: The Redbrands hassle every business in town, except for the Phandalin Miner's Exchange. They don't want trouble with Halia Thornton, who runs it.

nodes.name: Phandalin Miner's Exchange
nodes.description: A trading post where local miners have their finds weighed, measured, and paid out. It also serves as an unofficial records office.

nodes.name: Sleeping Giant Tap House
nodes.description: A location in Phandalin where the adventurers can confront the Redbrands.

nodes.name: Delivering the Supplies
nodes.description: The characters deliver the wagon of supplies to Barthen's and receive payment. Barthen is informed about Gundren Rockseeker's capture.

nodes.name: Barthen's News
nodes.description: Barthen informs the characters about the Redbrands causing trouble in town.

nodes.name: The Sleeping Giant
nodes.description: A rundown tap house frequented by Redbrand thugs, operated by Grista.

nodes.name: Edermath Orchard
nodes.description: Daran Edermath's home and apple orchard.

nodes.name: Redbrand Encounter
nodes.description: Daran Edermath wants adventurers to confront the Redbrands.

nodes.name: Quest: Old Owl Trouble
nodes.description: Daran asks the characters to investigate the Old Owl Well ruins where undead have been reported.

nodes.name: Old Owl Well
nodes.description: A ruined watchtower with a well, occupied by a mage and undead guardians.
nodes.boxed_text: As you crest a low ridge, you spy the crumbling ruins of an old watchtower standing amid the rugged hills. The place is so old that the walls are only mounds of rubble enclosing a courtyard of sorts, adjacent to the broken stump of an old tower. A colorful tent has been set up in the middle of the courtyard, but no one is in sight.

nodes.name: Joining the Order of the Gauntlet
nodes.description: Daran Edermath approaches certain party members to join the Order of the Gauntlet.

nodes.name: Recovered Goods
nodes.description: The characters return the stolen goods found in area 8 of the Cragmaw hideout.

nodes.name: Halia's Job Offer
nodes.description: Halia offers the characters 100 gp to eliminate the Redbrand leader and bring her any correspondence found in the leader's quarters.

nodes.name: Joining the Zhentarim
nodes.description: Halia Thornton approaches certain members of the group to urge them to join the Zhentarim after disposing of the Redbrand leader.

nodes.name: Alderleaf Farm
nodes.description: A farm owned by Qelline Alderleaf, a wise and pragmatic halfling farmer.

nodes.name: Carp's Story
nodes.description: Carp, a young halfling, tells the characters about a secret tunnel near Tresendar Manor.

nodes.name: Secret Tunnel
nodes.description: A secret tunnel in a thicket near Tresendar Manor, leading to the Redbrand hideout.

nodes.name: Quest: Reidoth the Druid
nodes.description: Qelline suggests visiting Reidoth the Druid for help with finding specific sites.

nodes.name: Ruins of Thundertree
nodes.description: An abandoned village devastated by the eruption of Mount Hotenow and plagued by strange zombies and mutated vegetation.
nodes.boxed_text:
Gradually, the trail becomes an old, overgrown lane winding between dilapidated buildings choked in vines and brush. Ahead of you, in the middle of the settlement, rises a steep hill, upon which stands a stone tower with a partially collapsed roof and an adjoining cottage. A dirt road hugs the base of the hill and wends its way between old stone houses, many of which are roofless ruins with interiors open to the weather. Other buildings appear more or less intact. The whole place is eerily silent.

A wooden sign is nailed to a post nearby. It reads: "DANGER! Plant monsters AND zombies! Turn back now!"

nodes.name: Shrine of Luck
nodes.description: Phandalin's only temple, dedicated to Tymora, goddess of luck and good fortune.

nodes.name: The Banshee's Bargain
nodes.description: Sister Garaele offers a quest to persuade a banshee named Agatha to reveal the location of a spellbook.

nodes.name: Conyberry and Agatha's Lair
nodes.description: The location where Agatha the banshee resides.

nodes.name: Joining the Harpers
nodes.description: Sister Garaele approaches certain party members to join the Harpers if they help learn the fate of Bowgentle's spellbook.

nodes.name: Townmaster's Hall
nodes.description: Sildar Hallwinter establishes himself here as an agent of the Lords' Alliance.

nodes.name: Orc Trouble Quest
nodes.description: Harbin offers 100 gp to deal with orcs near Wyvern Tor.

nodes.name: Wyvern Tor
nodes.description: A sizable hill with rugged terrain, where the orc camp is hidden.

nodes.name: Quest: Finding Cragmaw Castle
nodes.description: Sildar Hallwinter offers a reward for locating Cragmaw Castle and defeating the goblin chieftain.

nodes.name: Quest: Finding Iarno
nodes.description: Sildar asks the characters to investigate Tresendar Manor to find Iarno Albrek.

nodes.name: Iarno Albrek
nodes.description: A short, dark-bearded human wizard in his thirties, member of the Lords' Alliance.

nodes.name: Glasstaff
nodes.description: Alias of Iarno Albrek, leader of the Redbrands.

nodes.name: Redbrands
nodes.description: A group led by Iarno Albrek, known as Glasstaff.

nodes.name: Joining the Lords' Alliance
nodes.description: Sildar Hallwinter offers certain party members a chance to join the Lords' Alliance if they eliminate the goblin threat or uncover Iarno's treachery.

nodes.name: Tresendar Manor
nodes.description: Suggested location for players to investigate the Redbrand hideout.

nodes.name: Street Fight with Redbrands
nodes.description: A gang of Redbrand ruffians picks a fight with the adventurers in the street.

nodes.name: Confrontation at the Sleeping Giant
nodes.description: The characters confront the Redbrands at the Sleeping Giant taproom.
nodes.boxed_text: The Sleeping Giant is a ramshackle taproom at the east end of town. Four human ruffians linger on the covered porch, perched on empty ale barrels or leaning against the wall. They all wear grimy scarlet cloaks, their sullen stares fixed on you as you approach.

nodes.name: Redbrand Ruffian Encounter
nodes.description: The party encounters a group of Redbrand ruffians who demand their belongings.
nodes.boxed_text: Time for you to move on, strangers. Give us your stuff, and be on your way.

nodes.name: Redbrand Interrogation
nodes.description: Characters can capture or charm Redbrands to gain information.

nodes.name: Redbrand Defeat
nodes.description: Characters defeat the Redbrands, causing mixed reactions in town.

nodes.name: Redbrand Ruffians Encounter
nodes.description: Encounter with the Redbrand Ruffians where players can earn 400 XP if they defeat them.

nodes.name: Tresendar Manor Entrance
nodes.description: Entrance to the dungeon from Tresendar Manor.

nodes.name: Secret Tunnel Entrance
nodes.description: Entrance to the dungeon via a secret tunnel found by Carp Alderleaf.

nodes.name: Bugbear Reinforcement Area
nodes.description: Area where bugbears sent by the Black Spider reinforce the Redbrands.

nodes.name: Glasstaff's Chambers
nodes.description: Chambers of the Redbrands' leader, Glasstaff, located in the western end of the stronghold.

nodes.name: Old Crypts and Holding Area
nodes.description: Area near the old crypts where captives are held, guarded by skeletons.

nodes.name: Cellar
nodes.description: A large storage cellar beneath an old manor, with stone steps, a cistern, and barrels of provisions.
nodes.boxed_text: The door opens onto a five-foot-wide landing fifteen feet above a large cellar, with stone steps descending to the floor in two short flights. Another door stands beneath the stairs to the north. A large stone cistern occupies the western part of the room, whose walls are lined with kegs and barrels.

nodes.name: Cistern
nodes.description: A rectangular reservoir filled with cold, fresh water, located 10 feet deep with a rim 2 feet higher than the surrounding floor.

nodes.name: Secret Door
nodes.description: A secret door is located in the southwest corner of the room.

nodes.name: Developments Area
nodes.description: An area where no monsters or villains are found, but ruffians from area 2 may notice noise.

nodes.name: Ruffians Encounter
nodes.description: Ruffians from area 2 may creep into the room if characters make noise.

nodes.name: Secret Door Reveal
nodes.description: The last ruffian might reveal the secret door by fleeing in that direction if two are defeated.

nodes.name: Treasure in the Cistern
nodes.description: A satchel hidden in the cistern containing valuable items.

nodes.name: Barracks
nodes.description: A storeroom converted into living quarters for Redbrand ruffians.
nodes.boxed_text: This appears to be a storeroom pressed into service as living quarters. Two double bunks stand against the wall near the door, while barrels and crates fill the southern half of the chamber.

nodes.name: Treasure
nodes.description: The Redbrands have treasure in their belt pouches and cloaks hanging from the bunks.

nodes.name: Trapped Hall
nodes.description: Once the castle's foyer, this wide hall makes a dangerous battleground.
nodes.boxed_text: Doors stand closed to the north and south, with a crumbling mound of rubble partially obscuring the southern hall. To the east, a broad corridor ends in two more doors leading south and east. The corridor is cluttered with dusty rubble and fallen plaster from a partial collapse of the ceiling overhead.

nodes.name: Tresendar Crypts
nodes.description: A mausoleum where the elders of the Tresendar family were laid to rest.
nodes.boxed_text: Three large stone sarcophagi stand within this dusty crypt, and propped up against each sarcophagus is a human skeleton clad in bits of rusty mail. False columns along the walls are carved in the image of spreading oak trees. The double doors in the southeast corner are sheathed in tarnished copper plate.

nodes.name: Skeleton Encounter
nodes.description: Nine skeletons form from the bones and attack any living creature entering the room.

nodes.name: Developments
nodes.description: If combat erupts here, the goblins in area 9 cannot be surprised.

nodes.name: Sarcophagus Treasure
nodes.description: Discovery of an ornate gold bracelet amid bones in the sarcophagus.

nodes.name: Slave Pens
nodes.description: A long room partitioned into three areas with iron bars, used by the Redbrands to hold captives.
nodes.boxed_text:
This long room is partitioned into three areas, with iron bars walling off the north and south. Filthy straw lines the floors of those cells, the hinged doors of which are secured by chains and padlocks. A pair of disheveled human women are held in the cell to the south, while a human boy is confined to the north. All are dressed in plain gray tunics and have iron collars fitted around their necks.

A heap of discarded clothing is piled carelessly against the far wall.

nodes.name: Cell Doors
nodes.description: The cell doors have simple locks that can be picked or forced open.

nodes.name: Captives
nodes.description: The Dendrars are imprisoned by the Redbrands and plan to be sold into slavery.

nodes.name: Mirna's Heirloom
nodes.description: Mirna offers information about a hidden heirloom in Thundertree.

nodes.name: Defeat Ruffians
nodes.description: The party defeats the ruffians.

nodes.name: Dendrars Safe Return
nodes.description: The Dendrars make it back to town alive.

nodes.name: Armory
nodes.description: A room filled with weapon racks and red cloaks, used by the Redbrands to stockpile arms and armor.
nodes.boxed_text: Racks of weapons line the walls of this chamber, including spears, swords, crossbows, and bolts. A dozen dirty red cloaks hang from hooks by the door.

nodes.name: Storeroom and Work Area
nodes.description: A chamber where the Redbrands take stock of their stolen wares, with finished stone walls and a flagstone floor.
nodes.boxed_text:
This area is the north end of a large natural cavern, but it has been finished with dressed stone block walls and a flagstone floor. Several barrels are stored against the walls here, along with a number of empty crates, straw for packing, hammers, pry bars, and nails.

The cavern continues for some distance to the south. You can make out several passages that open up off the larger cavern, and what looks like a deep pit or crevasse in the floor.

nodes.name: Crevasse
nodes.description: A steep-sided fissure that is 5 to 10 feet wide and 20 feet deep, with rough walls that are easily climbed. The bottom is unnaturally cold and emanates a faint necromantic aura.

nodes.name: Nothic Encounter
nodes.description: Encounter with a nothic, a subterranean monster that guards the area.

nodes.name: Bridges
nodes.description: Wooden plank bridges with no rails, one rigged to collapse.

nodes.name: Nothic's Treasure
nodes.description: A hidden chest containing the nothic's hoard, including coins, gems, potions, a scroll, and a magical sword.

nodes.name: Guard Barracks
nodes.description: A small barracks with a stone brazier and straw pallets, guarded by hobgoblins.
nodes.boxed_text: A stone brazier full of coals glows in the middle of this small barracks. Four straw pallets are lined up along the east wall. The wall to the south has collapsed, but a barred wooden door in that direction is still clear. A curtain hangs in an archway to the north.

nodes.name: Role Playing Droop
nodes.description: Interaction with the goblin Droop, who is not a threat and can provide information about the Redbrand hideout.

nodes.name: Wave Echo Cave
nodes.description: A hidden location known to the bugbears.

nodes.name: Interrogate Bugbear
nodes.description: A character can interrogate a captured bugbear to learn the location of Wave Echo Cave or Cragmaw Castle.

nodes.name: Mosk's Treasure
nodes.description: Mosk carries a belt pouch containing 33 sp and wears an eye patch made of black leather set with semiprecious stones (50 gp). He also has an iron key that locks and unlocks all the doors in the Redbrand hideout.

nodes.name: Common Room
nodes.description: Headquarters and meeting room for the Redbrands, also serves as a common room for guards.
nodes.boxed_text:
Several worn tables and chairs are scattered around this large room. Wooden benches are drawn up against walls decorated with draperies of brown and red, and several ale kegs are propped up and tapped.

Four tough-looking human warriors wearing scarlet cloaks are gathered around one of the tables. A stack of coins and trinkets is heaped upon the tabletop between them.

nodes.name: Knucklebones Game
nodes.description: Four Redbrand ruffians are drinking and playing knucklebones, potentially turning acrimonious.

nodes.name: Wizard's Workshop
nodes.description: A wizard's workshop filled with alchemical devices and bookshelves.
nodes.boxed_text: This room appears to be a wizard's workshop. A rat scurries across the floor and takes refuge under a large worktable set up with alembics, retorts, distillation coils, and other alchemical devices, all of it stewing and bubbling away. Bookshelves are crowded with sheaves of parchment and strange-looking tomes.

nodes.name: Books and Notes
nodes.description: A room filled with books and notes on alchemy, including a tome in Dwarvish.

nodes.name: Iarno's Preparation
nodes.description: Iarno, the mage, prepares for the characters' arrival due to his telepathic bond with his rat familiar.

nodes.name: Encounter with Iarno Albrek
nodes.description: The party encounters Iarno Albrek and can choose to slay or capture him.

nodes.name: Iarno's Letter
nodes.description: A letter from Lord Albrek to Iarno instructing him to capture or kill strangers arriving in Phandalin.
nodes.boxed_text:
Lord Albrek,

My spies in Neverwinter tell me that strangers are due to arrive in Phandalin. They could be working for the dwarves.

Capture them if you can, kill them if you must, but don't allow them to upset our plans. See that any dwarven maps in their possession are delivered to me with haste.

I'm counting on you, Iarno. Don't disappoint me.

nodes.name: Iarno in Custody
nodes.description: If Iarno is captured, Sildar Hallwinter arranges for his incarceration.

nodes.name: Treasure Chest
nodes.description: A chest containing 90 ep, 120 gp, a potion of healing, a scroll of silence, and a scroll of revivify.

nodes.name: Sildar Hallwinter
nodes.description: Sildar Hallwinter is an NPC in Phandalin who the party can deliver Iarno to.

nodes.name: The Spider's Web
nodes.description: The characters follow up on existing leads and lines of inquiry, setting out into the forests and hills surrounding Phandalin.

nodes.name: Conyberry
nodes.description: Ruined town where the banshee Agatha resides.

nodes.name: Thundertree
nodes.description: Ruined town where the druid Reidoth can be consulted.

nodes.name: Triboar Trail
nodes.description: A stretch of foothills and roiling, sparsely wooded plains extending between the Sword Mountains and Neverwinter Wood.
nodes.boxed_text: Phandalin lies in a part of the North known as "the Triboar Trail," "the Triboar Cutoff," or "the Cony Gap." This stretch of foothills and roiling, sparsely wooded plains extends between the Sword Mountains to the south and Neverwinter Wood to the north. The area gains its name from an old trail that runs from the distant town of Triboar to the east, winding westward about one hundred miles through the abandoned village of Conyberry, then running north of Phandalin on its way to the High Road along the coast.

nodes.name: Overland Travel
nodes.description: The characters will be marching overland from one point of interest to another, covering distances of forty to fifty miles over several days.

nodes.name: Wilderness Encounters
nodes.description: Random encounters that occur while traveling on the Triboar Trail.

nodes.name: Stirges Encounter
nodes.description: Flying predators drawn to campfires at night.

nodes.name: Ogre Encounter
nodes.description: Encounter with 1 Ogre.

nodes.name: Goblins Encounter
nodes.description: Goblins know the location of Cragmaw Castle and can provide directions if captured and threatened.

nodes.name: Hobgoblins Encounter
nodes.description: Hobgoblins seeking adventurers to collect a bounty.

nodes.name: Orcs Encounter
nodes.description: Orc scouts looking for travelers to ambush.

nodes.name: Wolves Encounter
nodes.description: Wolves roaming the wilderness.

nodes.name: Owlbear Encounter
nodes.description: The party encounters an owlbear and can choose to defeat it or release it.

nodes.name: Ghouls Encounter
nodes.description: Undead humans that hunger for living flesh.

nodes.name: Conyberry Ruins
nodes.description: The ruins of the town of Conyberry, sacked by barbarians years ago.

nodes.name: Agatha's Lair
nodes.description: The lair of the banshee Agatha, located a few miles outside the ruins of Conyberry.
nodes.boxed_text: The forest grows dark and still as the trail winds deeper into the trees. Heavy vines and thick layers of moss drape the branches, and the air is noticeably colder than it was in the ruined village. Rounding a bend in the trail, you see a screen made from the warped branches of trees standing close together, woven into a dome-like shelter in the shadows. A low doorway leads inside.

nodes.name: Inside Agatha's Lair
nodes.description: The interior of Agatha's lair, sparsely furnished with elven craft.
nodes.boxed_text: A home of sorts is sheltered within the dome of woven branches. It is sparsely furnished with chests, shelves, a table, and a reclined couch, all of it old and of elven craft.

nodes.name: Agatha Encounter
nodes.description: Encounter with the banshee Agatha, who manifests shortly after the characters enter her home.
nodes.boxed_text: The air grows cold, and a powerful feeling of dread grips you. A cold, pale light flickers in the air, rapidly taking on the form of a female elf, her hair and robes waving in a spectral wind. She might have been beautiful once, but a hateful expression twists her features now. "Foolish mortals," she snarls. "What do you want here? Do you not know it is death to seek me out?"

nodes.name: Dealing With Agatha
nodes.description: The characters encounter Agatha the banshee and can ask her one question if they are respectful and polite.
nodes.boxed_text: The ghostly figure smiles with cold amusement. "Very well," she says. "I know that you seek many things. Ask me one question, and I will give you an answer."

nodes.name: Zombie Encounter
nodes.description: Twelve zombies lurk inside the crumbled shell of the old watchtower.

nodes.name: Hamun Kost Appearance
nodes.description: Hamun Kost, the evil mage, emerges from his tent if a battle erupts.

nodes.name: Red-Robed Mage
nodes.description: Encounter with Kost, a red-robed mage with necromantic tattoos.
nodes.boxed_text: "What is the meaning of this?"

nodes.name: Hamun Kost's Tent
nodes.description: A comfortable traveling suite with a cot, chair, writing desk, supplies, and a chest of clothes.

nodes.name: Quest Completion
nodes.description: Completion of the quest given by Daran Edermath in Phandalin.

nodes.name: Parley with Hamun Kost
nodes.description: The party parleys with Hamun Kost.

nodes.name: Defeat Hamun Kost
nodes.description: The party defeats Hamun Kost and his zombies.

nodes.name: Thundertree General Features
nodes.description: Overview of the general features of Thundertree, including buildings and natural elements.

nodes.name: Westernmost Cottage
nodes.description: A crumbled stone cottage with no roof, surrounded by rampant weeds.
nodes.boxed_text: Cowering in the shadow of an old tree is a crumbled stone cottage with no roof. Weeds are rampant here.

nodes.name: Blighted Cottages
nodes.description: Ruined cottages that were once homes of prosperous shopkeepers or well-off farmers.
nodes.boxed_text: These ruined, side-by-side cottages look as though they might have been the homes of prosperous shopkeepers or well-off farmers in their time. All that remains are collapsed walls and piles of debris. Several young trees have grown up in the midst of the ruins.

nodes.name: Twig Blight Encounter
nodes.description: Encounter with six twig blights hidden among the foliage.

nodes.name: Eastern Cottage
nodes.description: A cottage with a hidden treasure chest under the flagstone floor.

nodes.name: Twig Blights Encounter
nodes.description: Six twig blights lurk in the thicket south of the ruin.

nodes.name: The Brown Horse
nodes.description: A former tavern known for its excellent ale, now sagging and dilapidated.
nodes.boxed_text: A weathered signboard by the door of this large building shows the faded image of a workhorse holding a flagon of ale. The building is sagging and dilapidated, but it is more intact than the ruins across the road.

nodes.name: Ash Zombie Encounter
nodes.description: Five ash zombies attack if any living creature disturbs their rest.

nodes.name: Ash Zombies
nodes.description: Zombies created by the magical devastation of Mount Hotenow's eruption.
nodes.boxed_text:
These zombies were created by the magical devastation when Mount Hotenow erupted thirty years ago. They use the zombie stat block, with the following additional trait.

***Ash Puff.*** The first time the zombie takes damage, any living creature within 5 feet of the zombie must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on it early with a successful save.

nodes.name: Druid's Watch
nodes.description: Reidoth's camp in Thundertree, a small house in better condition than nearby ruins.
nodes.boxed_text:
This small house appears to be in better condition than the ruined and dilapidated structures nearby. The doors are reinforced with heavy iron bands, and thick shutters protect the windows.

Reidoth is a gaunt, white-bearded human who doesn't use two words when one word will do. Though he receives very few visitors, he is reasonably hospitable.

nodes.name: Reidoth's Cottage
nodes.description: The cottage where Reidoth resides and provides information to the characters.

nodes.name: Cragmaw Castle Directions
nodes.description: Reidoth provides directions to Cragmaw Castle.

nodes.name: Wave Echo Cave Offer
nodes.description: Reidoth offers to guide the party to Wave Echo Cave in exchange for a favor.

nodes.name: Reidoth's Transformation
nodes.description: Reidoth transforms into a gray squirrel and escapes if attacked.

nodes.name: Joining the Emerald Enclave
nodes.description: Reidoth invites certain party members to join the Emerald Enclave after they help him.

nodes.name: Blighted Farmhouse
nodes.description: A ruined farmhouse half swallowed by a dense thicket, with trees growing through its foundations.
nodes.boxed_text: This ruin looks as if it might once have been a farmhouse. It is now half swallowed by a dense thicket, with trees growing up through its ruined foundations. The lane continues south a short distance past the ruin before ending in an overgrown field.

nodes.name: Ruined Store
nodes.description: A former general store, partially ruined with some of its tile roof still intact.
nodes.boxed_text: At an intersection near the middle of the village, a narrow lane winds up the steep hillside to the north. Directly to the south is a ruined building that might have been a store or workshop. Webs stretch across the lane, from the building to the trees on the north side of the road.

nodes.name: Giant Spider Encounter
nodes.description: Two giant spiders hide on the inner walls of the ruined building, ready to attack prey moving through the webs.

nodes.name: Webs
nodes.description: A section of the path is covered in webs, making it difficult terrain. Creatures must succeed on a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check to move through or risk being restrained.

nodes.name: Ruined Building
nodes.description: A ruined building to the south of the webs.

nodes.name: Twig Blights Area 5
nodes.description: An area to the south of the ruined building where twig blights are located.

nodes.name: Treasure
nodes.description: The corpse of an unfortunate adventurer is cocooned in spider silk in the western half of the building.

nodes.name: Dragon's Tower
nodes.description: A tower formerly home to a human wizard, now claimed by a young green dragon named Venomfang.
nodes.boxed_text:
At the top of the hill stands a round tower with a cottage attached. Both are in good condition, although half of the tower's roof is gone. A door leads into the cottage, and several arrow-slit windows are visible in the tower. You can't help but notice an eerie quiet in the area and a strange, acrid smell in the air.

The corpses of two hideous giant spiders are sprawled near the edge of the pathway, apparently dragged there. Their bloated bodies are puckered and blistered, and appear to have been mauled by a large animal.

nodes.name: Tower
nodes.description: A single room tower with a 40-foot-high ceiling and a staircase leading to the rooftop.

nodes.name: Cottage
nodes.description: A cottage with dusty furniture draped in webbing, but nothing of value.

nodes.name: Venomfang Encounter
nodes.description: Encounter with the dragon Venomfang.

nodes.name: Old Smithy
nodes.description: An abandoned smithy with a wide chimney and rotted piles of firewood.
nodes.boxed_text: A wide chimney and rotted piles of firewood jumbled outside the walls of this sagging building suggest that it was a smithy in its day.

nodes.name: Herbalist's Shop
nodes.description: A ruined herb and alchemy shop belonging to Mirna Dendrar's family.
nodes.boxed_text: This ruined shop is cluttered with sagging storage shelves and broken furniture. Shards of glass and pieces of pottery glint in the weeds and rubble next to rotted books and casks.

nodes.name: Town Square
nodes.description: A small square on the east side of town with several ruined buildings and a larger intact structure that looks like a barracks.
nodes.boxed_text: On the east side of town, the lane opens up to form a small square. Several ruined buildings surround the south side of the square, but a larger, intact structure to the north looks like a barracks. One lane leads southeast, another heads southwest around the hill in the middle of the town, and a third way meanders north. In the middle of the square, leaning to one side ever so slightly, is a weathered wooden statue of a warrior clutching a spear and shield.

nodes.name: Old Garrison
nodes.description: An old barracks that served as a small keep in times of emergency.
nodes.boxed_text: The barracks appears to have weathered the years better than most buildings in town. Its rooftop features a simple battlement, and arrow-slit windows confirm that it was built to serve as a small keep in times of emergency.

nodes.name: Weaver's Cottage
nodes.description: A fallen cottage that attracts nearby creatures.
nodes.boxed_text: Heaps of wreckage litter the interior of this ruin. In one corner stands a broken loom.

nodes.name: Area 13
nodes.description: Cultists are present and will investigate loud noises.

nodes.name: Dragon Cultists
nodes.description: A group of cultists seeking to ally with a green dragon.
nodes.boxed_text: This small farmhouse appears to be just another empty home at first glance. However, all the doors are shut and windows shuttered.

nodes.name: Cultist Encounter
nodes.description: The party encounters a group of cultists led by Favric, who are not interested in fighting and prefer to be left alone.

nodes.name: Main Room Treasure
nodes.description: Favric's treasure in the main room includes a coffer with three diamonds and a potion of flying.

nodes.name: Orc Band
nodes.description: A band of orcs from the Many Arrows tribe, led by Brughor Axe-Biter, currently occupying Wyvern Tor.

nodes.name: Orc Camp
nodes.description: The hidden camp of the orcs at Wyvern Tor.
nodes.boxed_text: The faint smell of smoke hangs on the air as you ascend a rugged ridge on the lower slopes of the hill. Fifty yards away, a cave mouth opens up at the bottom of a ravine. Hunkered down by a boulder twenty yards outside the cave, keeping watch, is a single orc.

nodes.name: Orc Cave
nodes.description: The cave where the orc marauders are located.

nodes.name: Treasure Cave
nodes.description: A cave containing a treasure chest with coins and vials of perfume.

nodes.name: Wyvern Tor Encounter
nodes.description: Encounter with orcs and an ogre at Wyvern Tor.

nodes.name: Phandalin Quest
nodes.description: Quest given by Townmaster Harbin Wester in Phandalin.

nodes.name: Old Owl Well Promise
nodes.description: Promise to Hamun Kost at Old Owl Well.

nodes.name: Castle Entrance
nodes.description: The entrance to the castle with crumbling towers and a shadowed hall.
nodes.boxed_text: The castle consists of seven crumbling towers of different sizes and heights, but the upper stories are all in varying states of collapse. A short flight of steps leads up to a terrace in front of the main entryway. Past the wreckage of a pair of sundered doors lies a shadowed hall. Round towers loom over the entranceway, with dark arrow slits looking down on the terrace.

nodes.name: Goblin Sentries
nodes.description: Goblin sentries in area 3 are supposed to be keeping watch.

nodes.name: Goblin Defense
nodes.description: Goblins shoot arrows from behind arrow slits if they spot the characters.

nodes.name: Disguised Entry
nodes.description: Characters might try to talk their way inside by disguising as Redbrands.

nodes.name: Goblin and Hobgoblin Attack
nodes.description: Goblins and hobgoblins attack from both directions, trying to overwhelm the adventurers.

nodes.name: Trap
nodes.description: A copper tripwire connected to linchpins hidden in the ruined ceiling, triggering a cave-in if not avoided.

nodes.name: Archer Post
nodes.description: A small room in Cragmaw Castle used by goblin sentries to defend the castle.
nodes.boxed_text: This small room is littered with debris. The arrow slit opposite the door offers a fine field of fire over the terrace in front of the castle gates.

nodes.name: Ruined Barracks
nodes.description: The southwest tower of the castle is little more than a heap of rubble. Several ragged bedrolls are scattered across the remaining floor space, and a small, twisting passage leads east through the ruins.
nodes.boxed_text: The southwest tower of the castle is little more than a heap of rubble. Several ragged bedrolls are scattered across the remaining floor space, and a small, twisting passage leads east through the ruins.

nodes.name: Storeroom
nodes.description: A storage area filled with old casks of salted meat and sacks of rotting grain, along with a bloody suit of chain mail, a heavy crossbow, and an unsheathed longsword with the emblem of Neverwinter.
nodes.boxed_text: Old casks of salted meat and sacks of rotting grain fill this storage area. Among the supplies, you see a bloody suit of chain mail, a heavy crossbow, and an unsheathed longsword with the emblem of Neverwinter worked into its hilt.

nodes.name: Sildar's Gear
nodes.description: The chain mail and longsword belong to Sildar Hallwinter. Sildar is grateful if at least his longsword is returned to him.

nodes.name: Hobgoblin Barracks
nodes.description: A barracks where hobgoblins are quartered, with weapons and signs of damage on the north wall.
nodes.boxed_text: Four plain straw pallets and bedrolls are lined up on the floor of this barracks. Brackets on the walls hold a number of weapons—spears, swords, morningstars, and more. The north wall shows signs of damage, but the floor is swept clean of rubble.

nodes.name: Banquet Hall
nodes.description: A former banquet hall now used as a goblin mess hall.
nodes.boxed_text: The western portion of this large hall ends in a wall of rubble, but the remainder is still intact. This must once have been the castle's banquet hall, with a soaring ceiling twenty-five feet high. Two large wooden tables with plain benches stand in the middle of the room, and a brass brazier full of glowing coals is tucked into one corner. Dirty dishes, half-full stewpots, moldy heels of bread, and gnawed bones cover the tables.

nodes.name: Dark Hall
nodes.description: A high, narrow hall that might have been part of a chapel or shrine, with angelic figures sculpted along the upper reaches.
nodes.boxed_text: This high, narrow hall looks as if it might have been part of a chapel or shrine at one time. Angelic figures are sculpted along the room's upper reaches, looking down on the floor below. To the north, heavy curtains block a matching pair of archways. Between the archways is a cracked but ornately carved stone brazier.

nodes.name: Grick Encounter
nodes.description: A grick, the special pet of the goblin Lhupo, hides in the shadows and attacks intruders.

nodes.name: Treasure in the Brazier
nodes.description: A stone brazier containing a hidden gold statuette of a sun elf.

nodes.name: Goblin Shrine
nodes.description: A shrine dedicated to Maglubiyet, the god of goblins and hobgoblins, located in the northern tower of the castle.
nodes.boxed_text: This chamber occupies the northern tower of the castle. A stone altar stands in the middle of the room, covered with bloodstained black cloth. Golden ritual implements—a chalice, a knife, and a censer—are carefully arranged on top of the altar. Two archways to the south are covered with heavy curtains.

nodes.name: Arrow Slits
nodes.description: The arrow slits are 15 feet above the ground outside, and the creatures here aren't keeping watch.

nodes.name: Ruined Tower
nodes.description: A nearly collapsed tower with a hidden entrance, rotting crates, and ancient barrels.
nodes.boxed_text: This tower has almost completely collapsed, although the ground floor still has a little open space. Rotting crates and ancient barrels show that provisions were once stored here. A heavy curtain blocks a crumbling area to the south, and an intact door leads east. To the north, a short passage through the rubble ends before a screen of canvas.

nodes.name: Owlbear Tower
nodes.description: A dark, collapsed tower where an owlbear is confined.
nodes.boxed_text: The upper floors of this tower have collapsed to create a hollow silo at least thirty feet high, and the upper reaches of the room are lost in shadows. Dust, rubble, and broken glass cover the floor, and old worktables and bookshelves lie strewn to the south. In the middle of the room is a hulking beast that looks like a mangy bear with an owl's head. It rears up and roars when it sees you.

nodes.name: Area 11
nodes.description: A location in the castle through which the owlbear might flee.

nodes.name: Tower's Second Floor
nodes.description: A jagged ledge on the tower's second floor with a battered wooden chest.
nodes.boxed_text: All that remains of the tower's second floor is a jagged ledge, upon which sits a battered wooden chest.

nodes.name: King's Quarters
nodes.description: A crude living space with thick furs, old trophies, a large bed, and a brazier of coals. A round table with several chairs stands near the door, and an unconscious dwarf lies on the floor.
nodes.boxed_text: This chamber has been set up as a crude living space, with thick furs thrown on the floor to serve as carpets, old trophies hanging on the walls, a large bed to the north, and a brazier of coals burning brightly. A round table with several chairs stands to the south near the door. Near the table, on the floor, is an unconscious dwarf who looks badly beaten.

nodes.name: Negotiation Event
nodes.description: King Grol and Vyerith are negotiating the price for the map of Wave Echo Cave.

nodes.name: Ambush Encounter
nodes.description: Vyerith hides behind the door to attack intruders from the rear if warned of an imminent attack.

nodes.name: Northwest Room
nodes.description: A partially collapsed chamber that was once a comfortable bathroom.
nodes.boxed_text: This partially collapsed chamber was once a comfortable bathroom. It still contains a large tile tub, unused by the castle's current occupants.

nodes.name: Unconscious Dwarf
nodes.description: A room with an unconscious dwarf named Gundren Rockseeker.

nodes.name: Grol's Death
nodes.description: If Grol is killed, Vyerith tries to kill Gundren and flee with the map.

nodes.name: Gundren Revived
nodes.description: If Gundren is revived, he thanks the party but won't leave without his map.

nodes.name: Grol's Treasure
nodes.description: Discovery of treasure hidden under Grol's bed.

nodes.name: Defeat King Grol
nodes.description: The party defeats King Grol, the wolf, and the doppelganger.

nodes.name: Rescue Gundren Rockseeker
nodes.description: The characters rescue Gundren Rockseeker and escort him safely back to Phandalin.

nodes.name: Returning War Band
nodes.description: A hobgoblin war band returns home as the characters prepare to leave.

nodes.name: Hobgoblin War Band Encounter
nodes.description: Encounter with a hobgoblin war band.

nodes.name: Wandering Monsters
nodes.description: Random encounters with various monsters based on a dice roll.

nodes.name: General Features of the Mine
nodes.description: The mine is cold, damp, and surprisingly drafty with a noticeable breeze flowing from area 1 toward area 16.

nodes.name: Walls
nodes.description: The walls are hewn stone, with some areas dressed with well-fitted stone blocks.

nodes.name: Stalagmites
nodes.description: Spires of rock rising from the floor in natural caverns, can be used for cover.

nodes.name: Booming Waves
nodes.description: A unique feature of Wave Echo Cave where the rhythmic thunder of pounding waves echoes throughout the mine.

nodes.name: Cave Entrance
nodes.description: The entrance to Wave Echo Cave, hidden within the Sword Mountain foothills.
nodes.boxed_text:
The entrance tunnel leads into a large cavern supported by a natural pillar of rock and containing three stalagmites. In the western part of the cave, behind the column of rock, are three bedrolls and a heap of ordinary supplies—sacks of flour, bags of salt, casks of salted meat, lanterns, flasks of lamp oil, pickaxes, shovels, and other gear. Amid the supplies, you see the body of a dwarf miner, dead for at least a week.

The northeastern section of the cavern has collapsed, forming a ten-foot-wide, twenty-foot-deep pit. A sturdy hemp rope is tied off around a nearby stalagmite and dangles down the side of the pit, at the bottom of which is a rough-hewn tunnel heading northwest and east.

nodes.name: Open Pit
nodes.description: A pit that requires a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check to climb without a rope. Falling results in bludgeoning damage.

nodes.name: Treasure: Tharden's Boots
nodes.description: Tharden wears a pair of boots of striding and springing.

nodes.name: Mine Tunnels
nodes.description: A maze of passages in an old section of Wave Echo Cave's original mine site.
nodes.boxed_text: This area consists of numerous intersecting passages. The ceilings here are only six feet high, and several of the passages end in partially excavated rock faces.

nodes.name: Ochre Jelly Encounter
nodes.description: An ochre jelly stalks the group, waiting for an opportunity to attack a lone target.

nodes.name: Old Entrance
nodes.description: The original entrance to Wave Echo Cave, now a cavern with intersecting tunnels and historical carvings.
nodes.boxed_text: Many tunnels intersect at this natural, thirty-foot-high cavern. The walls are carved with simple reliefs showing dwarf and gnome miners hard at work. Below them, nearly two dozen skeletons in rusted scraps of armor are scattered across the cavern floor. Some are dwarf skeletons, while others are orc remains. Half a dozen large brass lanterns stand in niches or on ledges around the cavern, but none are lit.

nodes.name: Stirge Encounter
nodes.description: Ten stirges cling to the ceiling, ready to attack unsuspecting adventurers.

nodes.name: Old Guardroom
nodes.description: A guardroom that once protected the entrance to the mine, now filled with rubble and bones.
nodes.boxed_text: Splintered stone benches and heaps of rubble from a partially collapsed ceiling fill this room. Amid ruined stone bunks and toppled weapon racks are the bones of several dwarves and orcs.

nodes.name: Assayers' Office
nodes.description: The mine's assayers worked here, weighing and assessing ore samples and paying the minors for their labor.
nodes.boxed_text: This chamber was once an office or storeroom of some kind. A large stone counter bisects the room, set with three dusty balance scales made of iron. Cubbyholes carved into the north wall are stuffed with dusty paper scraps. Several long-dead corpses—gnomes and orcs by their look—are sprawled across the floor.

nodes.name: Treasure Strongbox
nodes.description: A locked iron strongbox behind the counter containing coins.

nodes.name: South Barracks
nodes.description: A miners' barracks where skilled delvers rested between shifts.
nodes.boxed_text: Old stone bunks in orderly rows line the walls of this chamber, and a corroded iron brazier full of old coals stands near the middle of the room. The bones of a half dozen dwarves and orcs lie strewn about, clad in scraps of armor. Three gray, hunched figures squat among the remains, pawing at the scraps and gnawing on the bones.

nodes.name: Ruined Storeroom
nodes.description: A storage area with a collapsed eastern wall and a secure storeroom to the north.
nodes.boxed_text: The eastern wall of this chamber has collapsed into a mass of rubble. To the north, a door stands ajar, leading to a good-sized storeroom. Dusty kegs are tucked neatly against the walls, all of them cracked and split open from age.

nodes.name: Fungi Cavern
nodes.description: A cavern filled with various fungi, some of which glow with an eerie green phosphorescence.
nodes.boxed_text: Dense carpets of weird fungi cover large sections of the floor in this cavern. The growth includes puffballs a foot across, weird shelf fungus growing on stalagmites, and large stalks and caps a good five feet tall. Some of the puffballs glow with an eerie green phosphorescence.

nodes.name: Poison Gas Cavern
nodes.description: A cavern where carpets of fungi release poisonous gas when crossed.

nodes.name: Great Cavern
nodes.description: A large cavern divided into three sections with high ledges and a lower middle section, used as a banquet room and meeting area.
nodes.boxed_text: Steep escarpments divide this large cavern into three sections—high ledges at either end, and a lower section in the middle. Carved stone stairs climb up to the ledges. Two large tables stand in the middle section, along with a pair of old braziers. A smaller table stands on the eastern ledge. The skeletal remains of dozens of dead warriors—dwarves, gnomes, orcs, and ogres—attest to the fierceness of the fighting that took place here long ago.

nodes.name: Ghoul Encounter
nodes.description: Seven ghouls lurk in the shadows on the western ledge, ready to attack any light or noise.

nodes.name: Dark Pool
nodes.description: A water-filled cave with a concealed treasure.
nodes.boxed_text:
A still pool fills much of this cavern. The water is dark, revealing little of what might lie within. The shore of the pool consists of a thin layer of broken shells from strange, pale mussels, and a fishy odor hangs in the air.

A passage leads south from this area, and a set of steps climbs up to the east. A sluggish stream flows out of the cave to the northeast.

nodes.name: Skeleton Discovery
nodes.description: Discovery of a skeleton of a human wizard at the bottom of the pool.

nodes.name: North Barracks
nodes.description: A former barracks now occupied by bugbears, with a barricaded eastern door.
nodes.boxed_text: Old stone bunks line the walls of this barracks, which is lit and heated by a glowing iron brazier in the middle of the room.

nodes.name: Barricaded Door
nodes.description: The eastern door is barricaded and requires a DC 20 Strength check to open.

nodes.name: Bugbear Encounter
nodes.description: Encounter with bugbears and a doppelganger.

nodes.name: Treasure
nodes.description: The largest bugbear carries a pouch containing 15 cp, 13 ep, and a potion of vitality.

nodes.name: Smelter Cavern
nodes.description: A large chamber with a blast furnace and mechanical bellows, guarded by undead.
nodes.boxed_text:
A blast furnace and a mechanical bellows powered by a waterwheel dominate this large chamber. The furnace is cold and dark, but heaps of coal are piled nearby, along with carts full of unrefined ore. The waterwheel sits in a ten-foot-wide channel cut into the floor of the room, but the channel is dry. Passages exit to the west, south, and east. The empty channel exits to the north and east.

More than a dozen withered corpses are scattered around the room. These slain dwarves and orcs are still wearing the remnants of their armor. Floating above them is a skull engulfed in green flame.

nodes.name: Forge of Spells
nodes.description: A large workshop where wizards allied with dwarves and gnomes channeled magic to enchant items. It was damaged by an ancient spell battle.
nodes.boxed_text:
This large workshop was badly damaged by the ancient spell battle that laid waste to the mine. Worktables taking up two corners of the room are scorched, and the plaster has been burned off the masonry walls. In the middle of the room, a stone pedestal holds a small brazier in which an eerie green flame dances and crackles. The brazier and its pedestal appear to have been untouched by the forces that destroyed this area.

Behind the brazier of green flame floats a spherical creature measuring roughly four feet in diameter. Four eyestalks protrude from its central mass, two on each side. In the center of the body is a large eye that stares at you. "Hello," says a thick, burbling voice inside your head.

nodes.name: Starry Cavern
nodes.description: A large cavern with glittering minerals in the ceiling, resembling a starry night sky. Contains two freestanding structures and scattered skeletons.
nodes.boxed_text:
Glittering minerals in the ceiling of this large cavern catch the light and send it back to create the impression of a starry night sky. Dozens of skeletons—many crushed under fallen debris—are scattered across the floor.

The cave is large enough that it contains two freestanding structures. Each of these stone buildings is proportioned for human use, as opposed to the dwarf-sized doorways and furnishings you've seen elsewhere in the mines. Both structures have battered and blackened masonry walls, their double doors cracked and scorched. The cavern is divided by an escarpment, into which a flight of stairs has been cut.

Passages lead out of this area to the north, south, and west.

nodes.name: Northern Building
nodes.description: A building in the Starry Cavern with a stronger magical aura.

nodes.name: Southern Building
nodes.description: A building in the Starry Cavern with battered and blackened masonry walls.

nodes.name: Wizards' Quarters
nodes.description: A room damaged by a destructive blast, containing charred furnishings and a scorched iron chest.
nodes.boxed_text: Dust, ash, walls blackened by fire, and heaps of debris beneath the sagging ceiling show that this room was damaged by a destructive blast. The furnishings—tables, chairs, bookshelves, beds—are charred or splintered, but otherwise well preserved. A scorched iron chest stands near the foot of one of the beds.

nodes.name: Mormesk's Appearance
nodes.description: Mormesk the wraith rises up out of the floor when a living creature enters the room.

nodes.name: Encounter with Mormesk
nodes.description: The characters encounter Mormesk, a wraith, who is protective of its treasures.
nodes.boxed_text: Your presence is offensive to me, your life forfeit. My treasures are mine alone, not yours to plunder!

nodes.name: Map Discovery
nodes.description: Discovery of a map sewn into the cover of a tome, leading to a new dungeon.

nodes.name: Spectator Encounter
nodes.description: Encounter with a deranged spectator guarding the Forge of Spells.

nodes.name: Brazier of Green Flame
nodes.description: A magical brazier that can temporarily enchant weapons and armor.

nodes.name: Northern Room
nodes.description: A small room used as a workspace for preparing items for enchantment. It has been almost completely destroyed.

nodes.name: Booming Cavern
nodes.description: A water-filled cavern with a surging body of water and rhythmic booming sounds.
nodes.boxed_text: A narrow ledge overlooks a large cavern that houses a surging, seething body of water. The rhythmic booming heard throughout the mines is louder here. At regular intervals, a fresh surge of water funnels into this chamber and slams against the wall just below the ledge. The echo suggests that this cave might be one arm of a much larger cavern to the northeast.

nodes.name: Old Streambed
nodes.description: A low passage that used to be a streambed, now obstructed by boulders and pebbles.
nodes.boxed_text: This passageway is barely four feet high and is obstructed by rounded boulders and pebbles. It might have been a streambed, though no water flows here now.

nodes.name: Rift
nodes.description: A 20-foot deep rift that requires a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check to climb without a rope.

nodes.name: Area 19
nodes.description: Location where Nezznar can be warned.

nodes.name: Treasure in the Rift
nodes.description: Discovery of a dwarf skeleton with gauntlets of ogre power buried under rubble.

nodes.name: Temple of Dumathoin
nodes.description: Nezznar's headquarters while exploring the mines and searching for the Forge of Spells.
nodes.boxed_text:
Six cracked marble pillars line the walls of this hall, at the north end of which stands a nine-foot-tall statue of a dwarf seated on a throne, a mighty stone warhammer across his lap. Large emeralds gleam in the statue's eyes.

The dust and debris covering the floor has been swept to one side, and a campsite of sorts now spreads in front of the statue. Half a dozen bedrolls and packs are neatly arranged around a rough-built fire pit. A wooden table stands on the west side of the room between two pillars.

nodes.name: Nezznar Encounter
nodes.description: Encounter with Nezznar and his giant spiders.

nodes.name: Statue Room
nodes.description: A room containing a statue of Dumathoin, the dwarven god of mining, with emerald eyes that are actually glass.

nodes.name: Ceiling Collapse
nodes.description: The ceiling collapses if a jewel is removed from the statue's eyes.

nodes.name: Table
nodes.description: A table covered with notes and maps related to Nezznar's exploration of the mine.

nodes.name: Creatures Arrival
nodes.description: Creatures from area 18 arrive after 3 rounds if not dealt with.

nodes.name: Nezznar Capture
nodes.description: Capture Nezznar alive and deliver to Sildar Hallwinter or Townmaster Wester for double XP.

nodes.name: Nezznar Escape
nodes.description: Halia Thornton breaks Nezznar out of jail and delivers him to the Zhentarim.

nodes.name: Nezznar's Treasure
nodes.description: Nezznar carries a potion of healing, a spider staff, and an iron key. He has collected treasure in a sack on a wooden table.

nodes.name: Priests' Quarters
nodes.description: A room formerly belonging to the priest in charge of Dumathoin's temple, now used by Nezznar as a cell.
nodes.boxed_text: Dusty draperies adorn the walls of this room, which also contains a bed and brazier. A badly disheveled dwarf lies bound and unconscious on the cold stone floor.

nodes.name: Nezznar's Room
nodes.description: Nezznar's base of operations, where he and his allies are located.

nodes.name: Nundro's Rescue
nodes.description: Nundro is grateful if the adventurers rescue him and offers to tag along.

nodes.name: Safe Rest Area
nodes.description: A safe and comfortable place to rest after dealing with Nezznar and his minions.

nodes.name: Conclusion
nodes.description: The adventurers have defeated the Black Spider and reclaimed the lost mine of Wave Echo Cave.
nodes.boxed_text: With hard work and a little luck, the adventurers have defeated the Black Spider and undone his destructive plots, cleared Phandalin of the ruffians who threatened its people, and reclaimed the lost mine of Wave Echo Cave. Their deeds will be long remembered in this corner of the Sword Coast. In years to come, the restored mines of the Phandelver's Pact will bring great riches to Phandalin and help establish peace and prosperity in the area.
